shipments.title: Production-line spares
shipments.brief: A factory has grouped replacement components for its next maintenance shift. Carry the consolidated shipment to the receiving distribution station.

shipments.title: Medical equipment
shipments.brief: Move packaged diagnostic equipment to a regional distribution center for onward road delivery.

shipments.title: Industrial replenishment
shipments.brief: Connect two regional distribution points with a consolidated shipment of factory components.

shipments.title: Retail replenishment
shipments.brief: Bring a mixed shipment of retail goods to a receiving depot preparing its next distribution round.

shipments.title: Automotive supply run
shipments.brief: Move replacement assemblies to a regional parts center supporting several customers.

shipments.title: Project cargo connection
shipments.brief: Fly the air leg of a project shipment. The receiving team handles onward road transport; these are multiple crates, not a certified oversized load.

shipments.title: Technology distribution
shipments.brief: Deliver a consolidated technology shipment to a distribution station preparing customer orders.

shipments.title: Healthcare supply run
shipments.brief: Move laboratory equipment and non-temperature-controlled medical supplies for regional distribution.

shipments.title: Maintenance work package
shipments.brief: A maintenance team is preparing its next work package. Deliver boxed components and tooling together.

shipments.title: Factory components
shipments.brief: Carry a consolidated factory shipment between regional logistics centers.

shipments.title: Distribution connection
shipments.brief: Carry the air segment of a shipment with onward warehouse and road distribution.

shipments.title: Supply-chain connection
shipments.brief: Connect a dispatch warehouse with a receiving logistics center using a PAC freighter.

shipments.title: Project supplies
shipments.brief: Transport a consolidated project shipment to the airport nearest the receiving logistics team.

shipments.title: Regional spares delivery
shipments.brief: Move replacement parts and workshop supplies between regional distribution points.
